name: Heighten Rage
body:
You can use your divine channeling to send a raging creature into a truly divine fury.

Prerequisite(s): Channeling class ability, Combat Channeling, Rage subdomain.

Benefit(s): As a standard action which does not provoke an attack of opportunity, you may utilize one of your uses of channel energy to increase the potency of a character’s rage. The character affected must be within the range of your channeling and must already be raging. Once affected, for the duration of the rage, all numerical benefits and penalties derived from that rage are doubled. When the rage ends, the individual is fatigued, if applicable, for twice as long as normal.
